reviews.title: The Best Workout App in the World
reviews.body: Update, June 24, 2026 - I’ve been using this app for a while and I like it even more than when I started.  One of the rare and fantastic things about the workouts is that they are genuinely well thought out, really nicely put together.  It seems a person sat down and thought this through and put the exercises in the right order and the most beneficial exercises.  So, there are no surprises.  The workouts do what they say they will do.  Anyway, I do wish they’d put out some new PROGRAMS, though I’m sure at some point they will.   ———-         I am absolutely crazy about this app.  It has everything, almost (no tai chi, yet).  All types of exercises and yoga . . . Of various lengths.  I am on a 30 day dumbbell program right now.  The variety of exercises in that one program is amazing.  I’ve never seen some of those moves.  Also, doing a 7-minute workout in the morning; love those unique moves, too.  Basically, you get this and you don’t need anything else.  I downloaded dozens of workout apps and this is the one who stood out way, way above the others; nothing even compares. Totally love it!

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.body: I started using this app when I was in the Marines and am now using it postpartum! I still love it! I have purchased the membership a couple times with breaks in between. So I like how convenient it is to be able to take a break. No match for an expensive gym membership. I prefer this for its simplicity and motivational content. I can work around my babies naps now that I’m almost a year postpartum. I’m also easing my body back into movement by doing the postpartum recovery plan! There’s so many options. And I have a bad back and knee problem, along with shoulder issues too. Just need to listen to your body. Check it out!!

reviews.title: Not Free (239.88 YEARLY)
reviews.body:
I only got to do one session for free. Now it wants me to pay for a subscription.
The ‘deal’ I was given was 
12 Months for 29.99. (84% Off)
The Non-Discounted Monthly Payment is 19.99. 
So yearly it’ll be around 239.88 after your deal gets dropped. 
Ridiculous.

I currently can’t afford to pay the monthly fee for the better experience this app will give me. I wish they made it completely free. While I do understand this is somebody’s income I believe there could have been other ways in the app they could have added a price tag that wouldn’t be so restricting for the free users.

reviews.title: Lack of Transparency
reviews.body: My app updated and I no longer have access to Free with Ads. Though the free option with ads is shown when they promote the subscription, there’s actually no where to choose that option. You are only given the options of paying yearly or monthly. This lack of transparency is now making me lose my free access while also trying to force me to pay for this app. Have had this app for years and it truly has turned awful.
